_comment: English voice samples inside SPU sound banks (VAB entries of container BINs), --audio=en only. tools/voice/build_vab.py. Every sample is the PS1 English VAG verbatim, with the PS1 English bank's tone record for it (the PS1 pitch/volume that sample was made for). Project decision 2026-09-30: the two in-game banks (same pitch on both games); the title bank first resampled to the PSP rate (test43-45), then (project decision, same day) verbatim at its PS1 44.1 kHz pitch instead, to be tested on the title screen.

banks.what: title screen / title-menu selection voices (program 2, keys 60-62)
